notlar: Lanes inside a row are fixed offsets per protocol; they carry no value.
SVHN has two seed pairs: both values are drawn, no mean, no SD (as in the table and the sheet).
Per-direction rates and the both-correct paired analysis of the sheet (lines 167-195) are not drawn.
kararlar: Karar (duzeltme turu 2): seed pairs are lifted 0.09 row units above their lane (as in protocol_sets), so the SD whisker ends and the seed marks no longer coincide; the SD is drawn through annotate.errorbar (kind sd); the Unconditioned mark takes the emphasis stroke (0.55 pt) as edge instead of a darker palette tone (the palette is regenerated only by _palet_uret.py); the key names the SVHN encoding ('SVHN: two pairs', protocol marks on a thin line, no mean); 'L2' reads 'L₂'. Height 84 mm (ceiling 88).

Karar: protocol marks take the protocol family of the paper palette (tone and shape, as in protocol_sets), and seed pairs are small open ink circles, because the two light purples would vanish as open marks on the grey plot area.
Karar: the key stands under the axes inside the single card (naming step 1 allows one card).
